items.title: $400,000 in These 4 Dividend Stocks Could Pay $21,000 a Year, but 2 Already Cut Payouts
items.summary: A $400,000 chemical-sector income plan looks tempting until you notice that half of it already slashed payouts once. Which two names cut, and could the steadiest check in the group still hold up for a retiree?

items.title: 4 Chemical and Materials Stocks Yielding Over 4% for Retirees Who Want Income
items.summary: Retirees crowd into utilities and REITs while four chemical and packaging payers quietly offer fatter checks. Two have already slashed their dividends, and the real test is which payouts the cash flow can actually defend.

items.title: 4 S&P 500 Dividend Stocks Paying Shareholders More Than Their Free Cash Flow
items.summary: A fat yield looks like a gift until the cash behind it runs dry. Four household S&P 500 names are sending shareholders checks bigger than the money coming in, and one test shows which payouts may not survive.

items.title: Dow Already Cut Its Dividend 50%. Its Remaining 4.4% Yield Faces Another Test
items.summary: Dow slashed its payout in half while losing billions, and now a cash flow turnaround is rewriting the story for income investors. Before trusting the smaller check, weigh what the cycle, a rival's choices, and Middle East exposure could still do to it.

items.title: DOW's Shares Surge 41% YTD: What's Driving the Momentum?
items.summary: Dow's shares have surged 41.3% YTD, fueled by cost savings, productivity gains, high-return growth projects and feedstock advantages.

items.title: As Plastics, Package Makers Mark America Recycles Day, Hopes Run High for Action in Congress
items.summary: Industry groups are hoping new recycling rules make it through Congress. Critics say they’re trying to undermine state rules.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Dow Stock?
items.summary: Although Dow has outperformed the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a cautiously optimistic outlook about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Is Dow (DOW) Still Below Fair Value Or Is Its Recovery Already Priced In?
items.summary: Dow (DOW) is in focus after executive chairman and former CEO Jim Fitterling donated $25 million to Allegheny Health Network’s cancer center, prompting a renaming and highlighting the company’s leadership profile. Dow’s recent headlines arrive alongside strong share price momentum, with the stock at $33.15 after a 13.57% 30 day share price return and 36.59% year to date share price return. The 1 year total shareholder return of 51.71% contrasts with a 3 and 5 year total shareholder return...
